# ADR 0005: Circuit breaker per provider with priority failover for initialisation only

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Payment gateway integration hub

## Context

A slow or failing provider must not take checkout down, but a payment must never be created twice.

## Decision

Each provider call has timeouts and its own Resilience4j circuit breaker. Initialisation fails over to the next healthy provider; verify is retried with backoff and jitter; initialise is never retried blindly.

## Consequences

Checkout survives one provider outage. Some payments go to a costlier provider during outages.

## Alternatives considered

Retrying everything; one shared breaker for all providers.
